title: Webinar registration request (schemaVersion 1)
description: Body of POST /api/v1/registrations and POST /webinar-api/registrations. Structural schema only: the server additionally normalises fields, resolves aliases/per-form mappings, enforces the form's required fields, gates attribution by consent and rejects conflicts. Client consent claims are stored as client_claim evidence and are never server-verified.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated random value (UUIDv4 recommended). Reuse it to retry the same intent; generate a new one after a completed registration. Server regex: ^[A-Za-z0-9_\-:.]{8,128}$.

namespace.description: Lowercase, e.g. "crm", "salesforce_account". Browser-supplied ids are stored unverified.

value.description: Must contain a non-whitespace character; trimmed before storage.

disclosureVersion.description: Must identify the SMS disclosure shown (FormVersion.sms_disclosure_version) when granted is true.

parameters.description: Allowlisted URL parameters only: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content, utm_id; ValueTrack campaignid, adgroupid, keyword, matchtype, network, device, creative, placement, targetid, loc_physical_ms; click ids gclid, gbraid, wbraid, fbclid, msclkid, ttclid, twclid, ScCid, rdt_cid. Other keys (e.g. gad_source, utm_source_platform) are dropped server-side; click ids require advertising consent.

identifiers.description: Allowlisted first-party cookie identifiers (fbp, fbc, gaClientId, gclAw, gclAu, scid, rdtUuid, twclid). Canonical key for the GA4 client id is gaClientId (the SDK sends this; ga4ClientId and _ga are accepted as input aliases). Dropped unless the matching consent purpose is granted. Never used for authentication.

pageUrl.description: Query string and fragment are stripped before storage.

referrer.description: Query string and fragment are stripped before storage.

customFields.description: Keys must be listed in the form's custom_fields (with or without the "custom." prefix). Stored namespaced as custom.<key>.

profile.description: Canonical camelCase keys. Common snake_case aliases and the form's explicit field_mapping keys are also accepted (see docs/field-mapping.md). Blank or null values are ignored and never erase stored data.

phone.description: E.164 (+<country><number>) unless the form supplies a default region.
